purpose: Schema PRIOR only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative.
status_reason: Three employer career sites on Teamtailor render the same single-page application form at /jobs/<id>-<slug>/applications/new; fully observed including employer questions and consent checkboxes.

page_shape.route: employer domain (careers.<co>.com / jobs.<co>.com / <co>.teamtailor.com) /jobs/<id>-<slug> with button 'Apply for this job' then /jobs/<id>-<slug>/applications/new
page_shape.form: form#job-application-form POST /applications (form_index 0), submit input[type=submit] name=commit 'Submit application'; sections: employer questions (top), 'Personal information', consent block, cookie banner; hidden 'Log in as employee' / 'Log in to Connect' links are not gates

control_families.text: candidate[first_name], candidate[last_name] (maxlength 50), candidate[email], candidate[phone] (aria 'Phone number with country code', placeholder '+1 201-555-0123'); required shown as label suffix '* Required' (no required attr on these)
control_families.file: candidate_resume_remote_url 'Upload CV* Required' / 'Upload resume* Required' accept .doc,.docx,.pptx,.pdf,.pages,.txt,.rtf (required attr set); candidate_file_remote_url 'Additional files'
control_families.questions_text: candidate[answers_attributes][n][text] as input[type=text] (JUICE, Carr) or textarea (Rankings)
control_families.questions_boolean: radio pairs Yes/No name=candidate[answers_attributes][n][boolean] ids boolean-<qid>-true/false; question text above group ending '* Required' when required
control_families.consent: checkboxes candidate[consent_given] ('Required. By submitting this application, I agree that I have read the Privacy Policy…'), candidate[consent_given_future_jobs], candidate[consent_given_sms] (Carr)

runtime_observations: Requiredness is in label text ('* Required'), not attributes, except the resume input.
Employer questions precede personal info in DOM order.
Text-type questions may expect long answers despite being input[type=text] (JUICE).

provider_hint.for_jev: Teamtailor: single form; employer questions first (text, Yes/No, number), then first/last/email/phone, resume, additional files, cover letter, consent checkboxes. Required = '* Required' in label. Stop at 'Submit application'.

edge_cases: Domains vary per employer; detect Teamtailor by form#job-application-form and candidate[...] names.
